review.summary: Snapshot 7a636d18 vs 9c575c8: static allowlist, CSP, role-gated APIs, x402 alias to unmodified public/app.js, and order request_id retry look sound for the auth-on beefapi demo. Two P1/P2 contract bugs remain: local fixture mutation controls never open because /api/state omits authEnabled:false, and runAction/payX402/login do not take the old synchronous busy lock.

findings.title: Fixture mutation controls never open in auth-off mode
findings.body: source-support.authRequired(state) is true whenever state.authEnabled !== false, including when the field is missing. fixtureMutationsOpen therefore requires an explicit false. createApp state() only spreads { authEnabled: true, role } when auth is on; auth-off /api/state omits the field entirely. Session bootstrap does learn authEnabled:false from GET /api/auth/session, but snapshot applyState does setState(next) without copying that flag onto state. GlobalConsole and Wallet therefore hide /api/demo/commission, /api/partner/auto, /api/partner/transfer, and /api/demo/wallet in the documented local fixture+no-auth mode. web tests only pass { authEnabled: false } and never the live omitted-field payload. Public beefapi+auth demo is unaffected (source !== fixture). Working tree has already started injecting authEnabled in applyState; that patch is not in 7a636d18.
findings.recommendation: Treat the session flag as source of truth: applyState should stamp authEnabled from the session (or /api/state should always send authEnabled: false). Add a test that fixtureMutationsOpen({ source: 'fixture' }) is true, matching the auth-off payload.

findings.title: Busy lock is render-delayed, so pay/bind/login can overlap
findings.body: public/app.js lock(true) assigned busy synchronously before the first await. Partner runAction/payX402/login only check busyRef/loginBusyRef, then setBusy/setLoginBusy, and the refs update on the next render. A second click before paint passes the guard. Create-order is still idempotent via createIdRef + request_id. x402 pay and wallet bind are not: two pay() calls can both miss payloads.get(id) and open two signatures; two bindWallet flows can issue overlapping challenges. disabled={busy} does not close the pre-paint window. Same generation/401 handling as the old client is otherwise intact.
findings.recommendation: Set busyRef.current = true (and loginBusyRef for login/logout) before the first await, the same way lock(true) did, then keep the React state for the UI.

next_steps: Fix fixture visibility against the real auth-off /api/state shape and add a test that omits authEnabled.
Take the busy/loginBusy refs synchronously in runAction, payX402, and login.
Re-review only those two patches; do not treat the in-progress working-tree applyState edit as part of 7a636d18.

Limits: no .local/env/production inspection; Vite proxy and homepage images are host-owned; CSP was not relaxed and dist/index.html has no inline scripts; current hashed /assets/* names match staticFileFor.

disposition: Both findings independently verified and fixed; session authority stamped onto state; synchronous busy refs with pre-fix failing and post-fix passing regression tests. See OVERSEAS-ACCEPTANCE.md.
